Post 1

📈 ASX 200 hit a 100-day high Thursday, closing at 9,271.60 (+0.47%, +43.80pts) and sitting just 0.27% off its 52-week peak. Five-day gain: 3.39%. Gold stocks led the charge. The bull run is tightening. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

⛏️ Materials topped sectors at +1.11% as gold names surged. Health Care added +0.81%, Financials +0.45%. A-REITs were the clear laggard at -0.94% — rising rate sensitivity biting property again. #ASX #mining #ausbiz

Post 3

🪙 Pantoro Gold +9.95% to AUD 2.43, Westgold +5.43% to AUD 5.44, Regis +5.22% to AUD 7.05. Gold equities moved in lockstep with spot. When metal runs, the miners run harder. #ASX #gold #mining

Post 4

Gold at AUD 6,063.42/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7031. Silver AUD 88.39/oz. Platinum AUD 2,562.80/oz. A softer Aussie dollar amplifies every commodity gain for local producers. #gold #silver #commodities #ausbiz

Post 5

ASX sits 0.27% from its 52-week high. The question now: does Wall Street give the green light overnight to break it? Watch gold above AUD 6,063/oz as the key read. Where do you see the index by Friday close? #ASX #ausbiz #investing
